title: Completion Evidence
description: Validates the content of a completion-evidence artifact. Reports coverage at the acceptance-criterion level by joining work-unit criteria, behavior-contract scenarios, and test results, and records the documentation impact of the change.

work_unit.description: Common envelope — threads to work unit.

coverage-entry.description: Coverage status for a single acceptance criterion.

criterion.description: Acceptance criterion from the work unit.

scenarios.description: Scenario names that cover this criterion.

failures.description: Scenario names that failed for this criterion.

documentation-impact.description: Documentation impact of the change: what was updated, what was reviewed and confirmed accurate, and what deeper work was filed as follow-up.

updated.description: Documentation files updated in this change. Empty if none.

verified_accurate.description: Documentation reviewed and confirmed accurate without edits. Empty if none.

follow_up_work_units.description: Work-units filed for documentation follow-up that exceeds this change. Empty if none.
